verdict.rationale: Docs confirm the agent writes tests and can run code/tests in isolated sandboxes (codegen-docs-1, codegen-docs-5, codegen-docs-29), and PR review flows check test coverage before posting feedback (codegen-docs-20), supporting self-validation before proposing changes. However there's no explicit documented workflow describing the agent autonomously running its own generated tests specifically as a pre-proposal validation gate, nor independent hands-on evidence confirming this loop works reliably. missing for 10: explicit documented test-then-validate-before-PR workflow, independent/hands-on confirmation of self-validation loop.
